question: Which specific manufacturers are approved by the MUTCD to supply retroreflective sign sheeting?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD does not approve, endorse, or name any specific manufacturers of retroreflective sign sheeting. Instead, it sets performance-based requirements — signs must be retroreflective or illuminated, and sheeting is characterized by generic material type (e.g., beaded or prismatic sheeting per ASTM D4956) with minimum maintained retroreflectivity levels in Table 2A-5. No manufacturer names appear anywhere in the evidence provided. Standards (mandatory): - "Regulatory signs shall be retroreflective or illuminated (see Section 2A.21)." — a performance requirement, not a manufacturer specification. - "Requirements for retroreflection of the red circle and diagonal shall be the same as those requirements for backgrounds, legends, symbols, arrows, and borders." — again defined by performance, not brand. Options (permitted): - Highway agencies may exclude certain signs (Parking/Standing/Stopping R7 and R8 series; Walking/Hitchhiking/Crossing R9 series and R10-1 through R10-4b; Acknowledgment signs; and bikeway signs intended for exclusive use by bicyclists or pedestrians) from retroreflectivity maintenance guidelines — a decision framed around sign categories and performance levels, with no reference to any supplier. Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-5, which specifies minimum maintained retroreflectivity levels by generic sheeting type (ASTM D4956 Types I, II, III, and prismatic) and sign color — no manufacturers are listed. [Image 5] shows sign design provisions with no manufacturer references. [Image 4] illustrates enhanced conspicuity treatments (plaques, flags, retroreflective strips, beacons, LEDs) described generically, not by brand. Citations: - Section 2B.01 Standard §3 (p.67) - Section 2M.07 Standard §2 (p.523) - Section 2A.22 Option §5 (p.63) - Section 2A.22 Option §4 (p.63) - Table 2A-5 (p.62) Note: To the extent the question presumes the MUTCD maintains a list of approved sheeting manufacturers, the evidence is insufficient to identify any such list — because the Manual regulates by material performance criteria (ASTM D4956 sheeting types and minimum retroreflectivity values), not by supplier.
